sentences.text: Vincent Cassel -LRB- -LSB- vɛ̃sɑ̃ kasɛl -RSB- ; born Vincent Crochon , 23 November 1966 -RRB- is a French actor best known to English-speaking audiences through his film performances in Ocean 's Twelve and Ocean 's Thirteen , as well as Black Swan .	French	France	Black Swan	Black Swan (film)
Cassel is also renowned for playing the infamous French bank-robber Jacques Mesrine in Mesrine : Killer Instinct and Mesrine : Public Enemy Number One .	French	France	Jacques Mesrine	Jacques Mesrine
